title: LLM Chat Service (ChatGPT)
prompt: Design a chat service like ChatGPT: users send messages in conversations and receive streamed model responses. Inference runs on a limited, expensive GPU fleet.
functionalReqs: Stream the response token by token
nonFunctionalReqs: Fair use of scarce GPUs; graceful degradation under load

scale.qps: ~50K concurrent generations at peak; ~500 tokens per response

deepDives: Request queueing and batching on GPUs
